name: meli-comprador-mcp
description: Read-only Mercado Libre buyer MCP: search, offers, listings, reviews, seller reputation and Q&A, with auto-refreshing OAuth tokens and optional Apify web enrichment.

scripts.inspector: pnpm build && pnpm dlx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector node bin/mcp-server.mjs
scripts.inspector:auth: pnpm build && pnpm dlx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector -e MERCADOLIBRE_ACCESS_TOKEN="${MERCADOLIBRE_ACCESS_TOKEN}" -- node bin/mcp-server.mjs

author: dan1d, KolmenaAI, JoacoRea
